cases.notes: Classroom evidence measured in grades, removals and colleagues coached. A third competency is claimed honestly without a figure behind it.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: How do you handle a mixed ability class?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I planned differentiation into every lesson for a class of 31. Three tiers of task, and the middle tier is the one most pupils start on.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Did it change anything?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: After a term of differentiation the bottom quartile moved up 2 grades on average. Their books changed before their marks did.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Tell me about behaviour.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: My behaviour management plan cut removals from 9 a term to 2. The plan is on one page and every pupil has seen it.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Has that spread at all?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I now coach 4 colleagues on the same behaviour routines. Two of them have taken it into their own year group.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: And assessment?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I use low stakes assessment and feedback weekly but I have not measured the effect. It feels right rather than proven, and I know the difference.

evidence.quote_contains: I planned differentiation into every lesson for a class of 31
the bottom quartile moved up 2 grades
My behaviour management plan cut removals from 9 a term to 2
I now coach 4 colleagues on the same behaviour routines
I use low stakes assessment and feedback weekly

cases.notes: A trainee year. One example below the rubric's floor, one honest gap, one topic never reached. The remedies differ: ask a better question, or accept there is nothing to ask about.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Tell me about differentiation in your practice.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I ran one differentiation project with 5 pupils last year. It was a small group and the school did not repeat it.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: And behaviour?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I am not sure I have a behaviour management example that would help. My placements were in calm classes and I was rarely the one holding the line.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Assessment and feedback?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: We did not cover that in my training year. The mentor handled it and I watched from the back of the room.

evidence.quote_contains: I ran one differentiation project with 5 pupils
not sure I have a behaviour management example

cases.notes: A genuine conflict about one timetable, with differentiation evidence beside it so the contradiction is not the whole transcript.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: What was your teaching load?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I taught 5 classes a week in that school. Each one was a different year group which made planning slow.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Remind me of the timetable.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: There were 8 classes a week on my timetable in that school. That was the load for the whole year.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: How do you plan for mixed ability?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: My differentiation planning covers 3 tiers in every lesson. The tiers are named on the board so pupils choose openly.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Can somebody else pick that up?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The differentiation folder has 12 worked examples in it. Anyone covering my class can pick one up and run it.

evidence.quote_contains: My differentiation planning covers 3 tiers in every lesson
The differentiation folder has 12 worked examples

contradictions.why: Five classes a week and eight classes a week at the same school over the same year cannot both be the timetable.

cases.notes: The transcript itself is unreliable: mean word confidence well under the floor. Delivery cannot be measured through a bad transcript, and saying so is not a low result.

known_limitations: Content extraction still reads a low confidence transcript, because the words are what was transcribed. Whether a span from an unreliable transcript should be published at all is a policy question this dataset raises and does not answer.
